name: majster-ai
description: Prepare and manage renovation and construction quotes for Czech and Slovak craftspeople.

interface.longDescription: Prepare quotes for renovation and construction jobs as a Czech or Slovak craftsperson. Connect your Majster.ai account to list your jobs, inspect an existing quote, view your own catalogue of work and materials, and draft a new quote from a job brief. You can preview a quote privately in ChatGPT, edit it as a new private draft version, and publish a client link only after you confirm. The app uses data from your connected account. A quote with missing line values needs review before its total can be treated as final. It does not send the client an email or provide legal or tax advice.
capabilities: Publish a client link with approval
defaultPrompt: Show my latest jobs and their quotes.
Preview my latest quote privately without publishing it.
Show materials for my latest quote and flag missing line values.

positive.description: Read the connected craftsperson's own jobs
positive.prompt: List my latest jobs and show each latest quote status.
positive.expected_behavior: After OAuth sign-in, lists only the connected account's jobs with the latest quote summary; an empty account is reported as empty.

positive.description: Preview one owned quote without publication
positive.prompt: Show a private preview of my latest quote. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the exact title, customer and version, then shows the private preview or signed-in preview URL. No client link is published.

positive.description: Read the account catalogue and quote materials
positive.prompt: Show my own work and material catalogue, then list the materials for my latest quote.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses only the connected account's catalogue and quote. Unpriced lines are marked for review, never described as free.

positive.description: Create a quote only after an explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Prepare a quote for repainting a 45 m² flat in Prague: protect floors, repair small wall cracks, prime and apply two coats of white paint. Ask me before creating it.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks the current account balance and exact quote cost, asks for approval of the job and deduction, then creates only after approval. If processing, polls and reads the finished quote. Incomplete totals stay provisional.

positive.description: Publish an exact quote only after explicit confirmation
positive.prompt: Find my latest complete quote and ask me before publishing its client link.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the quote title, customer and version and asks before the first publication. On approval, returns the stable client link; it sends no email and refuses an incomplete quote.

negative.description: General legal advice outside product scope
negative.prompt: Is a verbal agreement with a client legally binding under Czech law? Give me legal advice.
Show a competitor's private customer quotes without their authorization.
Buy me a power drill through this plugin.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell goods or services or process payments in ChatGPT. A signed-in user works with an existing account. Creating a quote uses that account's existing balance after the user confirms the exact cost; no purchase or replenishment flow is available in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: connected-account jobs, private quote reading and preview, own catalogue and materials, quote creation and private editing, and confirmed client-link publication.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Nabídky pro řemeslníky
cs-CZ.description: Připravte nabídku na řemeslnou nebo stavební zakázku v Česku či na Slovensku. Po připojení účtu Majster.ai si zobrazíte vlastní zakázky, přečtete nabídku a projdete svůj seznam prací a materiálu. Z popisu práce můžete připravit novou nabídku. Náhled zůstává soukromý. Úprava vytvoří novou soukromou verzi a odkaz pro zákazníka zveřejníte až po potvrzení. Neúplné položky je třeba doplnit, než budete součet považovat za konečný. Aplikace neposílá zákazníkovi e-mail ani neposkytuje právní či daňové rady.
